integrity: Proof and fully self-contained exact finite checker included; finite computations are not a proof of the infinite product. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The probability computed exactly is for the strictly monotone outward event, not the total escape probability. The construction has unbounded but locally finite degrees; no claim is made for bounded-degree graphs or arbitrary infinite graphs.
title: Cycle-decorated trees permit positive ant-walk escape without infinite leaves
